thought: I've explored the website structure thoroughly. The event page shows: combobox with '一般・NT$10,000' (default) and 'VIP・NT$20,000', seat grid A1-J10 (60 seats), and a '保留 0 席' button. bash_command:
cat > /work/outputs/member_ticket_20261009_132402/plan.md << 'EOF'

- [ ] CP9: Report seat number, order amount, and ticket page content
EOF
cat /work/outputs/member_ticket_20261009_132402/plan.md
